svg.title: ML-Guided Primal Heuristics for Mixed Binary Quadratic Programs
svg.desc: Encode the instance as a tripartite graph, predict binary assignments with graph attention, and use predictions to construct a restricted optimization subproblem. Training combines contrastive and weighted cross-entropy losses. Quadratic-aware graph representation and combined solution-prediction training. Motion illustrates algorithm steps or system behavior; it does not reproduce reported numerical results.
